Subnet 10.0.1.0/24 (256 addresses):
  10.0.1.0   -> network address
  10.0.1.1   -> VPC router
  10.0.1.2   -> Amazon-provided DNS
  10.0.1.3   -> reserved for future use
  10.0.1.255 -> broadcast (reserved, unused)
